meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.1.8
§ Rei = "friendly"
a person of David's court who remained loyal during Adonijah's rebellion

elsewhere.note: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
